name: CoStar Tower
note: 26-storey, 510 ft CoStar HQ at 600 Tredegar St; topped out Feb 2025, completion 2026. Sits just NW of the existing CoStar Group building. Footprint is the oriented rectangle of the >60 m region in the VGIN/NOAA 2025 City of Richmond DSM (flown 2025-02-14..03-01, tower at ~147 m then); OSM/Overture/VGIN 2026-02 have no footprint for it. The earlier VGIN OBJECTID 1537705 footprint was the old Tredegar visitor-center block, 300 m west.

name: Allianz Amphitheater at Riverfront
note: 7,500-capacity amphitheater west of the CoStar campus, opened 2025; stage house; height estimated. Applies to the OSM relation 'Allianz Amphitheater at Riverside'.

name: Foundry Park South
note: Six-storey Foundry Park South at 551 S 5th Street, the CoStar campus mixed-use amenity building. Its south facade and terrace/plaza front Tredegar Street; footprint is traced from a current user-supplied construction image against the mapped street edges, since routine footprint sources still describe the former site. Height/role are corroborated by City planning material, CoStar and leasing sources. The low-poly model represents public mass-timber, glass, retail and terrace cues, not an architectural survey.

name: Allianz Amphitheater seating bowl
note: Terraced seating fan and paved plaza around the Allianz Amphitheater stage house (opened June 2025); traced from VGIN VBMP Most Recent Imagery (Spring 2025 frame, under construction) on 2026-09-09. Ring hugs the stage house so the OSM relation keeps its 22 m block; lawn to the NW left as ground.

name: Children's Hospital of Richmond at VCU
note: Children's Tower at 1000 E Broad St (opened 2023), the Children's Hospital of Richmond at VCU. OSM splits it into osm:way/224510150 (Broad St, 44.8 m) and osm:way/224510149 (Inpatient Pavilion, 65.1 m), both older than the 2025 City of Richmond LiDAR, which shows a ~64 m podium on Broad St and the tower rising to ~84 m with ~95 m plant. Footprint is the exact union of those two OSM outlines (no imagery tracing) so one landmark model can replace both.
